full_judgment: 3. The short facts relevant for disposal of this Rule are: the petitioner along with others inherited 0.145 acres of land appertaining to plot No. 196 (part) 212 (part) of CS Khatian No. 361 of mouza Natun Paltan including other properties of one Abdur Rahim. The petitioner's brothers and his other co-sharers of the said land constructed a kutcha structure thereon for saying prayers by the members of the family of late Abdur Rahim and they replaced the said structure later on by a building. Amena Khatun, one of the widows of late Abdur Rahim, got a decree on 18.1.1958 declaring that the property of Abdur Rahim was waqf property in Title Suit No. 45 of 1957 of the Court of Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka on the basis of a compromise petition. Thereafter the petitioner's brother and others filed Title Suit No. 24 of 1960 for declaration that the properties of Abdur Rahim were not waqf properties and the compromise decree made in Title Suit No. 45 of 1957 and enrolment of the properties as waqf properties with the Administrator of Waqf bearing EC No. 13274 on the basis of the said decree were illegal, void and collusive. The said suit was decreed on contest declaring the compromise decree made in Title Suit No. 45 of 1957 as collusive and the properties as secular property. Against the decree the Administrator of Waqfs took an unsuccessful appeal, First Appeal No. 151 of 1965, before the High Court of the then East Pakistan. The learned Judges of the High Court while affirming the judgment and decree of the trial Court held that the properties were not waqf properties. No appeal was preferred against that decree made in First Appeal to the Appellate Division. The petitioner asserts that he and his co-sharers have been enjoying the property and saying their prayers in the said mosque. But the Respondent No. 1 illegally passed the impugned order on August 14, 1985 (Annexure-D to this petition) declaring the mosque as "a waqf by user" and formed a Management Committee consisting of 11 members illegally and the Respondent No. 2 on receipt of the said order by an order dated October 6,1985 (Annexure-F to the petition) illegally directed the Secretary of the mosque to hand over the charge of the mosque to the President and the Secretary of the newly formed Management Committee by Respondent No. 1.
